name: Should I consider future resale when selecting a floor plan?

mainEntity.name: Should I consider future resale when selecting a floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely, you should consider future resale when selecting a pre-construction floor plan. While your new home should meet your current needs, choosing a floor plan with broad appeal can be a significant decision factor for future marketability. Common preferences in the South Florida market often include open-concept living, ample natural light, functional outdoor spaces, and a good bedroom/bathroom count balance. Highly customized or unusual layouts might limit your buyer pool later on. Kelby Contreras leverages experience in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and Collier counties to advise on floor plan elements that consistently attract buyers and retain value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, consider future resale when selecting a floor plan; widely appealing layouts often enhance marketability and value.
